reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a compositional hierarchy. Movement delta modeling (Primitive 1) operates on low-level tracking data, producing derived features that feed into the hierarchical projection model (Primitive 2). The no-raw-NGS fence (Primitive 3) acts as a regulatory constraint ensuring that proprietary NGS insights remain internal, preventing direct leakage to external systems. Mathematically, this corresponds to a factorization of the joint distribution $p(\text{data}, \text{model}) = p(\text{data}|\text{features})p(\text{features}|\text{model})$, where Primitive 1 provides $p(\text{features}|\text{model})$ and the fence ensures that certain factors of $p(\text{data})$ are never exposed.
